activity.notes: Reviewed temporary seed used only to mint official UN provenance for Sadat's 15 October 1970–1 September 1971 presidency while Egypt still officially bore the United Arab Republic name. Stage 2 transfers this source to the preserved original Sadat Activity, retires this seed, then splits the original at the 2 September 1971 change to Arab Republic of Egypt.

sources.title: United Nations — Egypt membership and state-name history
sources.citation_text: The United Nations records that on 2 September 1971 the United Arab Republic changed its name to the Arab Republic of Egypt.

review_context.decision_authority: United Nations Egypt member-state history; UN Treaty Collection historical information; #977 Egypt ancient/modern collapse
review_context.identity_note: Temporary provenance seed only. Egypt officially retained United Arab Republic through 1 September 1971 and used Arab Republic of Egypt from 2 September 1971. The seed must not survive Stage 2.
